rows.notes: The study is a narrative review (titled 'Review', Trends in Plant Science) synthesising UAV remote sensing literature in precision agriculture; it reports no own experiment, survey or validated model. The only own data is an illustrative thermal image of a vineyard (Figure 1) showing canopy temperature variation linked to terrain relief, presented as an illustration rather than as a study result on drainage mapping or irrigation optimisation. The review discusses drought stress detection with thermal cameras and notes precision irrigation requires drip or pivot systems, but does not itself show drones identifying poor drainage or optimising irrigation.
